'''Hariso''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. While stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in [[3642 BBY]], Hariso was infected with the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]].
